context.exploration_scope: Explored the Capability relationship axis (exact capability_refs set grouping) instead of E12's (goal_ref, experience_kind) method, over the full current Experience Layer (88 records)

problem: PHASE-SSI-S12/S14 exhausted E12's (goal_ref, experience_kind) grouping method without finding any real, independent new signal -- but that method only ever looks at one relationship axis; the real Experience Layer also carries a Capability axis (links.capability_refs) that had never been grouped on, and might reveal a real repeated pattern spanning different goals and different experience_kinds that E12's method structurally cannot see.

decision.decision_summary: 5 capability-groups qualify (count>=2). 4 excluded (already-known via E12/S4/S1/candidate overlap, GPU-root-caused, or insufficient content-grounded evidence after filtering out tag-only members). 1 genuinely new signals: sig_altaxis_capability_cap_dataset_management (2 grounded members). 0 promotion/policy-ization, 0 execution. Verdict: CANDIDATE_ONLY.

action.action_summary: Grouped the full current Experience Layer by exact capability_refs set; excluded every group overlapping E12 Pattern members, the S4 Principle evidence, S1-surfaced evidence, or existing candidate descriptions; excluded any group entirely GPU-root-caused; applied a content-grounding filter requiring the capability to be literally named in each members own problem/cause text before counting as real evidence; classified survivors with count>=2 grounded evidence as CANDIDATE_ONLY.

result.note: 1 genuinely new, content-grounded, capability-axis improvement signal(s) found -- CANDIDATE_ONLY, not applied, not promoted.

cause.root_cause_summary: E12's method groups by (goal_ref, experience_kind) only, so two Experience records that share a real underlying capability-level cause but differ on both goal and kind are structurally invisible to it -- switching the grouping axis to capability_refs, while still requiring real evidence-ref overlap exclusion and content-grounding (not just a shared tag), is what makes this a genuinely different, still-honest search rather than a relabeled repeat of E12.

lesson: When one honest detection method has been run to exhaustion, the correct next step is a genuinely different real relationship axis (Capability, not Goal+Kind) rather than re-running the same method with cosmetic changes -- and a shared tag across two records is not evidence on its own; the underlying real content has to actually mention the shared thing before it counts as grounded evidence for a signal.
